incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-4729 fired for router-proxy latency (p95 > 350ms) in us-west-2. Details: https://pagerduty.example/INC-4729

pagerduty: Triggered by alert rule `router-latency-p95` (threshold=350ms).

Maya S: acking — oncall taking it (Grace, I'm on call if you need me)

Grace (oncall): acked. looking... grabbing traces and recent deploys.

Jon C: FYI I saw a tiny rollout earlier to router-v3.3, but telemetry looked fine in staging.

Grace (oncall):
Checking traces: spans show increased queue_time on proxy workers, not upstream model latency.
Running `kubectl get hpa -n inference router-proxy -o yaml` to check autoscale.

Grace (oncall): pasted output:
```
NAME: router-proxy
minReplicas: 3
maxReplicas: 12
currentReplicas: 3
metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
```

Grace (oncall): currentReplicas stuck at 3 despite CPU at ~85% on nodes. suspect HPA controller lag or node provisioning delay.

Maya S: can you scale manually to reduce p95 quickly?

Grace (oncall): doing `kubectl scale deployment/router-proxy --replicas=6 -n inference` now.

eng-oncall-bot: Command executed by Grace (oncall): `kubectl scale deployment/router-proxy --replicas=6 -n inference`

Grace (oncall): scaled to 6. watching svc latency.

Jon C: also seeing a short spike in `node-provisioner` errors, new instance pool dipping due to a failed spot request. might be capacity churn in the ASG.

Grace (oncall): connecting those dots. If node provisioning is delayed, HPA won't get additional capacity and pods stay pending. but scaling the deployment to more replicas on existing nodes should help for a bit.

 ~2m later~

incident-bot: Alert automation: observed 2 more similar pager events in last 5m. Auto-suppression candidates: duplicate noise?

Grace (oncall): I'm seeing p95 drop from 420ms -> 180ms after the scale. there's a short rollback in queue length.

Maya S: customer-facing? any 5xx or correlation to endpoints?

Grace (oncall): No 5xx spike. Error budget graph flat. Only increased tail latency, so customer impact = minimal. I'm going to set the alert to muted for 10m to avoid churn while infra stabilizes.

Jon C: agree, but let's annotate the incident and keep PD not escalated. we should also open a followup to fix HPA probe.

Grace (oncall): muting alert rule for 10m (`/incidents mute router-latency-p95 10m`) and adding annotation: "manual-mute:scaling-in-progress, reason: node provisioning churn"

eng-oncall-bot: Running: `/incidents mute router-latency-p95 10m` — muted successfully.

Grace (oncall): updating runbook thread: https://internal.runbooks/router-latency (adding note about spot ASG fallback).

Jon C: filing a follow-up JIRA: INF-1298 — investigate spot request failure and add a fallback pool. assigning to infra team.

Maya S: thanks. I'll ping infra oncall to check ASG logs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4729 status changed: acknowledged by Grace (oncall). no escalation performed.

Grace (oncall): Handoff: I'm going to leave a small checklist for next oncall: 1) watch HPA controller logs (`kubectl logs -n kube-system hpa-controller-xxx`), 2) check ASG/spot events in cloud console, 3) ensure router-proxy replicas remain >=4 until autoscaler repopulates.

Maya S: adding customer impact note: "No customer-facing errors observed; transient p95 latency elevated for ~4m, mitigated by manual scale. Monitoring for ASG capacity reprovision."

Jon C: ETA for infra follow-up?

Maya S: infra oncall (alex) acked and says he'll look in 15-30m.

incident-bot: Auto-resolve check: no new alerts fired in last 6m. Candidate to close PD?

Grace (oncall): closing PD incident as resolved (no customer impact). adding short postmortem stub in #incidents later if infra finds root cause.

pagerduty: INC-4729 resolved by Grace (oncall).

Grace (oncall): TL;DR: transient node provisioning churn caused HPA to be ineffective -> short p95 spike. Manual scale to 6 replicas cut p95. No 5xx or customer errors. Muted alert to prevent flapping while infra stabilizes. follow-ups: INF-1298 (infra) and doc update on runbook.

Maya S: :white_check_mark: nice quick work. please add timeline to the JIRA when available.

Jon C: can we add a small playbook step to auto-scale down/up if node provisioning delay detected? will reduce manual ops for future.

Grace (oncall): noted. I'll draft the playbook addendum today and link it in the follow-up. handing to next oncall in 20m. :wave:

incident-bot: Thread closed for INC-4729 (no active pages).
